entry.title: Autotools Miscellany
entry.summary:
Introduction
This last part in this series on Autotools will cover miscellaneous things in Autotools that don’t really fit anywhere else. For many software packages, there are typically two versions of its “source tree,” that is the complete set of files that comprise it: A maintainer tree that contains the complete set of files as checked-out from source control. For git, this means there is also a .git subdirectory containing the files git needs to do what it does. A distribution tree (or dist tree) that contains the complete set of files resulting from un-tar’ing a downloaded tar file for a particular version of the software, and perhaps other files.
